description:
This high-octane, provocative CG-toon is meticulously crafted for adult audiences seeking an intense, sensory-driven experience. Moving far beyond the boundaries of traditional storytelling, this anthology dives headfirst into the lives of thrill-seekers who have utterly abandoned their moral compasses. The collection features a diverse array of taboo scenarios that explore the darkest corners of human desire and the raw electricity of forbidden encounters. 

From the bittersweet yet dangerously seductive reunion with a long-lost first love to the adrenaline-fueled, illicit risks taken by a subway predator, every chapter is designed to push limits. These are stories of individuals who live for the moment, indulging in deviant escapes that regular society dares not mention. With stunning, high-definition CG visuals that bring every scandalous detail to life, this collection invites you to witness a world of uninhibited passion and absolute deviation. Prepare yourself for an unapologetic descent into the deepest, most exhilarating depths of adult fantasy.

(Source: Lezhin US)
